snippet.title: Seikyu Let’s Go! — Demo Out Now
snippet.description:
The demo for Seikyu Let's Go! is out now on Steam!

Seikyu Let’s Go! is a cozy chaotic co-op road trip adventure for 1-4 players. Jump into a campervan built by yokai, explore mysterious landscapes, solve puzzles together, discover hidden creatures, cook around the campfire, and meet the locals along the way

Adventure awaits — Let’s Go!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4928080/Seikyu_Lets_Go
